title: Damine reborn
description: The UPDATED version of Damine. This modpack adds al the features of Damine but add some more QOL's and fun but unneccecery things.
body:
Mabye you have heard from Damine.

This is the new updates version.

This modpacks adds a lot more things.
Like QOL's but also fun buy uneccecery things, like "not enouge animations."

Damine is for the hardcore performace but a little bit more sparks.
And Damine reborn is more experimental.

This modpack is especially for you, when you like tweaking your mods to your liking.
Need somting simpler try Damine or Damine optimized.

I hope that you like the extra features and I love to hear feedback in my discord!
